description: Test file for the Kubernetes kubelet pod resources server API, including tests for listing, getting, and filtering pod resources with support for init containers and dynamic resources.

methods.name: TestListPodResourcesV1
methods.description: Tests listing pod resources with various configurations including devices, memory, CPUs, and dynamic resources.

methods.name: TestListPodResourcesUsesOnlyActivePodsV1
methods.description: Tests that only active pods are listed in the resources response.

methods.name: TestListPodResourcesWithInitContainersV1
methods.description: Tests listing pod resources including init containers and their resources.

methods.name: TestAllocatableResources
methods.description: Tests retrieval of allocatable resources (CPUs, devices, memory).

methods.name: TestGetPodResourcesV1
methods.description: Tests getting specific pod resources, including error cases and resource details.

methods.name: TestGetPodResourcesWithInitContainersV1
methods.description: Tests getting pod resources with init containers and their resources.
